items.title: 2.3 Ilm ki numaindagi ke dhaanche ke taur par mantiq (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of logic as a knowledge representation framework (PDF 26-27).

blocks.text: Mantiq (logic) durust istidlal ka ilm aur computer science ka ahem tasawwur hai. Yeh computers ko maloomat durust tareeqe se mehfooz karne, samajhne aur use karne mein madad deti hai, aur mantiq se pecheeda maloomat saade tareeqe se pesh ki ja sakti hain.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Mantiq computers ko haqaiq par 'sochne' aur faisle karne ka tareeqa deti hai, taqreeban dimagh ki tarah.

Computer science mein mantiq ka matlab qawaid se durust faisle karna hai. Yeh computers ko sach aur jhoot ki shart samajhne aur maloomat theek tarah process karne mein madad deti hai. Mantiqi statements programs aur algorithms mein use hote hain, jahan yeh program ke bahao ko control karte hain. Mantiq computer ke bohat se kaamon ki bunyad hai aur computers ko munazzam tareeqe se kaam karne deti hai.
Istidlal aur faisla sazi mein mantiq ka kirdar

Mantiq computers aur logon ko durust nataij nikalne mein madad deti hai. Faisle haqaiq aur qawaid se hote hain, jis se uljhan aur andaze khatam hote hain. Mantiqi istidlal masail qadam ba qadam hal karta hai; computers sahi amal chunne ke liye mantiq use karte hain, aur mantiq faislon ko yaksan aur durust rakhti hai. Yeh expert systems aur artificial intelligence mein use hoti hai.

blocks.title: Class activity
blocks.text: Guftagu karein ke mantiq faisle karne mein kaise madad deti hai. School ki zindagi ke baare mein saade if-then jumle likhein, maslan: 'Agar barish hui to hum andar rahenge.'

blocks.prompt: Computer science mein mantiq kya hai? Aik if-then qaida batayein jo program use kar sakta hai.
blocks.explanation: Qawaid se durust sach-ya-jhoot faisle karna jo program ka kaam control karte hain. Misal: agar password durust hai to account kholo; warna ghalti dikhao.

items: Mantiq: durust istidlal ka ilm; maloomat saadgi se pesh karti.
Programs mein mantiqi statements bahao control karte.
Mantiq yaksan, durust faisle deti; expert systems aur AI mein.
